technical-summary: Hardened the telemetry-only SPLIT_REDUCE observation writer by canonicalizing provider and handoff labels, emitting zero topology evidence when the device array is unavailable, and suppressing fallback depth when no handoff exists. Added focused source-contract tests for provider, handoff, fallback-depth, and topology normalization.
user-summary-candidate: Hardened HI18 SPLIT_REDUCE telemetry so provider, handoff, fallback-depth, and topology records fail closed when observation inputs are malformed.
